title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-002-010
doc_notes: This document is a collection of archival correspondence from civilians requesting information from the FAA regarding a 1986 Japan Airlines UFO sighting; no actual encounter reports are contained within, only requests for information about a known event.

encounters.summary: Multiple civilian inquiries regarding a 1986 Japan Airlines (JAL) flight encounter with a UFO over Alaska, often citing Paul Harvey's radio broadcast about the incident.
